notes: Single quiet, day-grouped agenda column maintained at all three widths — no dashboard grid, no competing panels.
No horizontal scroll or clipped content at the screen edge at 375px or 393px, the widths most prone to overflow.
Team names (Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Copa del Rey, Eliteserien incl. Norwegian clubs) render fully, no truncation that hides which sides are playing.
Channel/where-to-watch text present under each row; no foreign broadcaster (FOX/ESPN/Sky) spotted.
No broken image icons or empty boxes where flags/crests should render.
Header (wordmark, search), day headings, and footer all intact and aligned across widths.

Desktop (900px): floating 'Assistent' button rests over a mid-agenda Copa del Rey row, not the last agenda row or footer — matches the DESIGN.md-sanctioned floating-button idiom (WP-146 variant D), not a finding.

Pages are very long (many days of fixtures across several competitions) at full-page capture, which compresses per-row detail; gross layout/overflow/occlusion checks were still clearly assessable at this resolution.
